page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title block at top; a woodcut vignette with the motto "EXSPECTANDO" in the centre; imprint at the foot. A handwritten "R" in the left margin is not printed text.

main_text.l: Pro duabus Ecclesiarum in Gallia Protestantium Synodis Nationalibus;
Altera Alensone, anno CIɔ IɔC XXXVII : altera verò
Carentone, anno CIɔ IɔC XLV habitis :

page.notes: Woodcut vignette: two birds flying above a seated figure gazing upward, a landscape with water and hills, a scroll reading EXSPECTANDO. The handwritten "R" at the left margin and the stamp-like marks on the right are not printed text. Imprint line "Sumptibus Joannis Ravesteinii" is partly obscured at the left edge; the initial letter of "Sumptibus" is cut off by the edge of the scan. "CIɔ IɔC" is transcribed as printed (reversed-C numerals, rendered here as printed rather than converted).
